def modify_features(X, history):
    F = pd.DataFrame(index=X.index)
    
    # Calculate average price per customer
    avg_price_per_customer = history.groupby('customer_id')['price'].mean().reset_index()
    F['f_avg_price_per_customer'] = avg_price_per_customer.set_index('customer_id')['price'].reindex(F.index).fillna(0)
    
    # Calculate number of purchases per customer
    num_purchases_per_customer = history.groupby('customer_id')['days_ago'].count().reset_index()
    F['f_num_purchases_per_customer'] = num_purchases_per_customer.set_index('customer_id')['days_ago'].reindex(F.index).fillna(0)
    
    # Calculate average purchase frequency per customer
    avg_purchase_frequency_per_customer = history[history['days_ago'] > 0].groupby('customer_id')['days_ago'].mean().reset_index()
    F['f_avg_purchase_frequency_per_customer'] = avg_purchase_frequency_per_customer.set_index('customer_id')['days_ago'].reindex(F.index).fillna(0)
    
    # Calculate number of unique product types purchased per customer
    num_unique_product_types_per_customer = history.groupby('customer_id')['product_type_no'].nunique().reset_index()
    F['f_num_unique_product_types_per_customer'] = num_unique_product_types_per_customer.set_index('customer_id')['product_type_no'].reindex(F.index).fillna(0)
    
    return F
